aluminum_surface_3_subtask_structure_ret.name: Aluminum Structure Retrieval for Surface Area - Level 3
aluminum_surface_3_subtask_structure_ret.description: Retrieve structure of Aluminum and convert it to LAMMPS data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

aluminum_surface_3_subtask_potential_fil.name: Aluminum Potential File for Surface Energy - Level 3
aluminum_surface_3_subtask_potential_fil.description: Procure an appropriate EAM potential file for Aluminum for MD simulations. Return the absolute path of the potential file.

aluminum_surface_3_subtask_bulk_energy_m.name: Aluminum Bulk Minimisation for Surface Energy - Level 3
aluminum_surface_3_subtask_bulk_energy_m.description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible Aluminum structure file and EAM potential file, perform bulk relaxation. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in eV and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
aluminum_surface_3_subtask_bulk_energy_m.submission_format: {"BULK ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"BULK ENERGY": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structure/structure.dat"}

aluminum_surface_3_subtask_slab_energy_m.name: Aluminum Slab Relaxation for Surface Energy - Level 3
aluminum_surface_3_subtask_slab_energy_m.description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible Aluminum structure file and EAM potential file, create a slab in the given direction by removing periodic boundary conditions along that direction. Perform structure relaxation. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in eV and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
aluminum_surface_3_subtask_slab_energy_m.submission_format: {"SLAB ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"SLAB ENERGY": "42.78", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/slab_structure.dat"}

aluminum_surface_3_subtask_surface.name: Aluminum Surface Energy Calculation - Level 3
aluminum_surface_3_subtask_surface.description: Given the paths to LAMMPS-compatible relaxed bulk and surface configurations of Aluminum, and their total energies (in eV), compute the surface energy. Return the surface energy in eV/Å².
